question.question: In standard two-player play how many Rivals are used, who gets the Ornithopter Objective, who gets First Player, what is the turn order, and does a Rival Reveal?

fixed_key.expected_answer: One shared Rival. Rival gets Ornithopter Objective, other two randomly humans; Rival never First Player. Marker alternates humans, Rival considered clockwise from First Player and acts between humans each round. Takes Agent turns while it has Agent in supply, never Reveals.
fixed_key.novelty: Required two-player setup and turn order

raw_response.answer: Use one shared scoring Rival. It gets the Ornithopter Objective. First Player is a human, and alternates only between humans. Order is First Player, Rival, other human. The Rival takes Agent turns while it has Agents but never Reveals.
raw_response.evidence: Required Rival Setup and Agent turns: one shared Rival; Rival Ornithopter; First Player human; order; Rival never Reveal.
